messages:
sam: Quick Q — if we need an emergency cutoff for the realtime routing change in prod, who is allowed to flip it and what's the absolute-minimum audit we must attach?
anya: Oncall (primary) can perform the cutoff via the ops console. SRE lead or senior infra can act if oncall is unreachable. PMs/EMs should not flip. Follow the Cutoff Cribsheet runbook first.
jordan: TL;DR procedure i use: 1) create incident ticket, 2) post ticket + short blurb in #incidents, 3) flip cutoff, 4) capture logs + tag ticket, 5) plan rollback/forward.
katie: Important — include ticket id and a reason in the flag API call (we record that to the audit table). Also paste the checklist result back here.
sam: How do we actually flip it (short command)?
anya: Use the ops endpoint (flag_admin role required). Example curl:
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/flags/realtime-routing/cutoff" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"state":"off","meta":{"actor":"sam","ticket":"RD-1234","reason":"latency spike"}}'
```
jordan: Note: only tokens with role=flag_admin will be accepted. Vault path for ops tokens: secret/data/ops/flag_admin. Do not paste tokens in-channel.
ops-bot: ops-bot: audit event recorded: flag_change id=fc_98765 actor=sam action=off ticket=RD-1234 ts=1963123462
katie: After flip run the cutoff checklist (link in runbook). If any step fails, escalate to infra lead and leave the flag off. I'll be watching logs.
oncall: Oncall here — if you page me i can flip. If you're unsure, prefer setting canary_pct=0 rather than full off so we reduce blast radius.
anya: Canary option example:
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/flags/realtime-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"canary_pct":0,"meta":{"actor":"sam","ticket":"RD-1234"}}'
```
sam: Where do we look for the audit trail after the flip?
jordan: Cloud audit logs: projects/redwood-prod/logs/feature_flags. We also mirror to internal DB: ops.flags_audit. Quick query example: `SELECT * FROM ops.flags_audit WHERE flag='realtime-routing' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;`
katie: I'll correlate logs + traces once the action happens. If nothing obvious surfaces in 5 minutes escalate to infra lead.
sam: Ok creating RD-1234 and will page oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks — remember to include minimal context in the ticket and paste the checklist result back here so we have a clean audit trail.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder: per policy, any emergency flip must have ticket id and actor in the API payload; missing fields will auto-reject.
